Securidge Trace — PC activity review tool
==========================================

What it does
  Collects records such as connected USB drives and phones, opened files, deleted files,
  web history, cleared logs and clock changes into an easy-to-read report. No installation.

How to use (usually 1–3 minutes)
  1. Copy this folder to a USB drive (running from USB rather than the target PC is recommended).
  2. On the PC to check, double-click SecuridgeTrace.exe.
  3. If asked "Do you want to allow this app to make changes?", click Yes
     (administrator rights are needed to read devices, networks and logs).
  4. Check this PC -> confirm customer and reviewer -> tick "I am authorized" -> Start check
  5. Click Open report. Use "Print / Save as PDF" at the top of the report.

If "Windows protected your PC" appears
  This warning appears for new unsigned programs. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

Where results are saved
  In the data folder next to the program. Use History to reopen, recreate in another
  language, or delete. History contains personal data; delete what you no longer need.

Important
  - First-pass review only; not court evidence.
  - Use only on PCs you are authorized to check.
  - No record does not mean no activity.
  - Files sent via sync apps, messengers or mail, printing and screenshots cannot be seen.

Command line (advanced)
  trace.exe check --i-am-authorized --customer "Customer A" --analyst "Name"
  trace.exe analyze --input E:\ --output D:\results
